posts.title: Everyone's Building Their Own Agentic Team
posts.description: Teams should agree on what lives in the repo. Everything else, the harness, the plugins, the workflow, is turning into something as personal as your dotfiles.

posts.title: The Bottlenecks Are Moving
posts.description: Agentic coding tools are removing old implementation bottlenecks, but review, system knowledge, and idea quality are becoming the new constraints.

posts.title: Are We Learning the Wrong Things?
posts.description: Grappling with the uncomfortable question of what developers should even be learning when AI handles the problems we used to grind through for expertise.
